(b) WorldToken treats an embodied episode as a causal interaction with the physical world: each policy timestep contributes one world token to the temporal context, while the policy produces an action chunk that acts on the environment. The resulting observation provides the next world token, so the high-level sequence advances through successive policy timesteps.
